resources.string: Turn on the Picture shortcut to open Picture and Sound settings with Menu on your remote, even while a video plays.\n\nIn Android TV Settings, go to Device Preferences → Accessibility → Services. Choose Projector Guy Picture shortcut and turn it on. Select Allow if asked.
While the shortcut is on, Menu opens the projector settings in place of the menu in the app you’re using.
Press Menu from Home or while watching a video. Choose Image Settings or Audio Settings. Press Back to close the panel.
To restore the usual Menu button, turn off Projector Guy Picture shortcut in Android TV Settings.
